job.job_description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Backend Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable server-side applications.
The ideal candidate should have strong programming skills, experience with APIs, databases, and cloud technologies, and the ability to build secure, high-performance backend systems that support business applications.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications and services.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party APIs.
Develop scalable and secure server-side architecture.
Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following coding standards.
Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
Design and manage relational and NoSQL databases.
Troubleshoot and resolve application bugs and production issues.
Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps, and product teams.
Implement authentication, authorization, and data security best practices.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
Maintain technical documentation for APIs and backend services.
Stay updated with emerging backend technologies and industry best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in backend development.
Strong knowledge of one or more backend languages/frameworks: Node.js (Express/NestJS) Python (Django/FastAPI/Flask) Java (Spring Boot) PHP (Laravel) .NET Core (C#) Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Strong understanding of SQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis).
Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
Understanding of authentication methods such as JWT and OAuth.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or containerization is an advantage.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Preferred Skills Experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
Knowledge of caching mechanisms (Redis, Memcached).
Understanding of system design and distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
